## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive (Narrow/Weak). SPY (1W: -1.67% | 1M: +0.63%) ↓ falling | CORRECTION and TLT (1W: -1.24% | 1M: -3.16%) ↓ falling | BELOW TREND show mixed stock/bond signals while VXX (1W: +4.99% | 1M: -5.66%) ↑ rising | RECOVERY underlines short-term sentiment volatility.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?  
Commodity/energy repricing: BNO (1W: +14.26% | 1M: +25.65%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND and XLE (1W: +4.14% | 1M: +9.03%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND are dominant drivers. Credit and rates are lukewarm: HYG (1W: -0.71% | 1M: -0.34%) → flat | BELOW TREND and LQD (1W: -1.15% | 1M: -2.09%) ↓ falling | BELOW TREND.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?  
Neutral-to-tighter: SPY/TLT neutral with TLT (1W: -1.24% | 1M: -3.16%) ↓ falling | BELOW TREND and HYG/LQD mixed, signaling no clear easing in conditions.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?  
Energy leading: XLE (1W: +4.14% | 1M: +9.03%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND; Utilities ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.71% | 1M: +2.43%) ↑ rising and Industrials ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.55% | 1M: +4.10%) ↑ rising. Tech lagging: XLK (1W: +0.52% | 1M: -3.12%) → flat | RECOVERY; style mixed / no clear leadership.

5. US vs Global?  
US lagging modestly: SPY (1W: -1.67% | 1M: +0.63%) CORRECTION while Emerging Markets RECOVERY: EEM (1W: +0.64% | 1M: -3.83%) → flat | RECOVERY and China FXI (1W: -0.20% | 1M: +4.96%) → flat | CORRECTION shows regional dispersion.

6. Speculative Appetite?  
Mixed appetite: IBIT (1W: +0.71% | 1M: +3.79%) → flat | ABOVE TREND shows continued crypto interest, ETHA (1W: -0.14% | 1M: +12.70%) CORRECTION signals profit-taking, and ARKK (1W: -3.70% | 1M: -3.72%) ↓ falling | BELOW TREND shows weak long-duration speculative flows.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?  
Commodities strong and broad: USO (1W: +16.92% | 1M: +25.37%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND, BNO (1W: +14.26% | 1M: +25.65%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND and CPER (1W: +0.47% | 1M: +2.47%) → flat | ABOVE TREND reflect reflation pressures. Gold mixed: GLD (1W: +1.80% | 1M: -1.54%) ↑ rising | RECOVERY.

8. Energy Trend?  
Clear leadership: XLE (1W: +4.14% | 1M: +9.03%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +14.26% | 1M: +25.65%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND, while natural gas UNG (1W: +1.82% | 1M: -7.74%) ↑ rising | RECOVERY shows episodic moves.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?  
CONFIRMED: Energy and Industrials show two-timeframe confirmation (ABOVE TREND). MAJOR Divergence present across core ETFs (SPY, XLK, XLF show 1W vs 1M mismatches) so strong regime calls are suppressed and market looks transitional.

10. Portfolio Direction?  
Favor energy/commodities exposures and select cyclical cyclicals via XLE (1W: +4.14% | 1M: +9.03%) ABOVE TREND and CPER (1W: +0.47% | 1M: +2.47%) ABOVE TREND while reducing exposure to clear tech momentum plays given XLK (1W: +0.52% | 1M: -3.12%) RECOVERY and ARKK (1W: -3.70% | 1M: -3.72%) BELOW TREND; bonds are neutral-to-weak with TLT (1W: -1.24% | 1M: -3.16%) BELOW TREND.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?  
BULLISH: XLE (1W: +4.14% | 1M: +9.03%) ABOVE TREND and XLI/industrial exposure (Industrials 1W: +2.55% | 1M: +4.10%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: XLK (1W: +0.52% | 1M: -3.12%) RECOVERY and Consumer Discretionary (1W: -4.53% | 1M: -2.82%) BELOW TREND.

12. Commodities to Watch?  
BULLISH: BNO (1W: +14.26% | 1M: +25.65%) ABOVE TREND, USO (1W: +16.92% | 1M: +25.37%) ABOVE TREND and WEAT (1W: +2.85% | 1M: +14.32%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: UNG (1W: +1.82% | 1M: -7.74%) RECOVERY remains vulnerable on monthly trends.

13. Key Levels?  
VXX ~20 (sentiment pivot), HYG/LQD ~0.80 (credit-health threshold), SPY/TLT key relative pivot (watch trend break), XLK/XLF relative ratio for growth vs value rotation.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive, with energy-led strength but broad market participation scarce. Energy and commodities showing strength while tech and several growth-oriented ETFs display multi-horizon divergence—monitor the major 1W vs 1M mismatches (SPY, XLK, XLF).
